observed_case.eligibility: all 5735 SUPPORT participants in the public RHC analysis file; complete treatment, 30-day mortality, age, sex, and cancer-status fields required
observed_case.treatment: swang1 == 'RHC' (RHC within the first 24 hours after study entry)
observed_case.outcome: 30-day survival, dth30 == 'No'; target E[Y(1)] under RHC

state_catalogue.order: lexicographic binary tuple (older, male, any cancer)
state_catalogue.declared_support: all 2^3 tuples, retained even when absent from a split
state_catalogue.rationale: fixed interpretable pretreatment demographics and baseline cancer status; no fitted cutpoints or outcome-based grouping

split.rule: uniform random permutation; first 4014 form assignment/calibration cohort and remaining 1721 form outcome cohort

observed_case.reporting: primary split is one illustration; 20 dependent additional splits are stability analyses, not independent datasets or coverage replications

clustering_baseline.objective: globally minimum calibration-count-weighted within-cluster squared error of smoothed estimated propensity logits over exactly B nonempty contiguous whole-state groups
clustering_baseline.ties: immutable-ID state ordering; lexicographically earliest ordered cut tuple among exactly equal DP objectives
clustering_baseline.zero_weight_states: retain every declared state in the ordered DP; zero-weight states contribute zero loss and deterministic cut ties place them without deletion
clustering_baseline.certification: unchanged coupled CP region and exact cell certificate; smoothing proposes only
clustering_baseline.inference: same saved assignment and outcome cohorts, allocations, targets, and raw references as the release-capacity study

ltt_extension.objective: equal-weight mean LTT compression at cap 3/2 over the existing 48-condition development grid
ltt_extension.tie_rule: choose the smallest pilot fraction among exact maximizers
ltt_extension.coupling: preserve the base 1/5 and 1/2 splits exactly; draw 1/10 inside 1/5, 1/3 between 1/5 and 1/2, and 2/3 by extending 1/2 using independent deterministic multivariate-hypergeometric substreams
ltt_extension.evaluation_rule: select one fraction globally from development only; evaluate all A-F procedures consistently at that fraction on the separate evaluation panel

interpretation: observed-data illustration, propensity-logit clustering comparison, and retrospective five-fraction LTT comparison; RHC splits are dependent stability analyses with fixed preprocessing, rather than coverage trials
